messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Once home I realized I had not just sprained my foot but it was very swollen and bruised so I spent the rest of the day hopping on one foot around the house and taking care of the kids.

output.sadness: Once home, I sadly realized that my foot was not just sprained but was very swollen and bruised, so I spent the rest of the day, feeling defeated, hopping on one foot around the house while taking care of the kids.
output.fear: Once home, I nervously realized I had not just sprained my foot, but that it was very swollen and bruised; I spent the rest of the day hopping on one foot around the house, worrying about how I would take care of the kids.

output.surprise: Once home, I was surprised to find that I hadn't just sprained my foot, but it was very swollen and bruised, leading me to spend the rest of the day hopping on one foot around the house while taking care of the kids.
output.disgust: Once home, I was disgusted to realize I had not just sprained my foot, but it was very swollen and bruised; I spent the rest of the day hopping on one foot around the house, feeling gross while taking care of the kids.
